verdict.rationale: Poly documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.poly.app/mcp, using streamable HTTP with in-browser OAuth, and an official Claude Code plugin that connects to it. A runtime probe confirmed the endpoint is live and returns the MCP OAuth challenge, with search, fetch and a virtual `poly` CLI exposed as tools. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of an authenticated agent session completing tool calls, and detailed per-tool reference documentation.
